lure: Christmas and New Year Eve tickets are on sale and selling fast
ask: Buy tickets at the club in person

message.body: Xmas & New Years Eve tickets are now on sale from the club, during the day from 10am till 8pm, and on Thurs, Fri & Sat night this week. They're selling fast!
